what: The posterior draws and metadata of the one finished HB-Stan fit (D=29, seed 0, 4 chains x 2000 warmup + 2000 draws), written by HBStanTrainer on HPC.
identity_link: The saved JSON's metrics.hb/fit_seconds equals this W&B run's hb/fit_seconds exactly (checked by recompute_stan_diagnostics.py). The trainer wrote fixed file names into one directory shared by every Stan run of the sweep, and only this run finished, so the files are its.
copied: 2026-10-14, by a recorded HPC job (ssh:hpc-code, 4b46d8c8) that copied the files and recorded the source sha256; the copy was verified equal.
